cards.title: Daniel Ek Backs Fusion Power Startup
cards.body: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. The startup is developing next-generation fusion energy solutions.

cards.title: AI and Human Solve Riemann Hypothesis
cards.body: An AI system claimed to solve the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, while a competing human solution also emerged. Mathematicians are examining both approaches with significant interest.

cards.title: Space Chips Face Financing Challenges
cards.body: Lenders are hesitant to finance chips destined for space due to concerns about collateral in orbit. The issue raises questions for the broader space data center industry.

cards.title: Nvidia Reports Growth Amid CEO Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia delivered healthy earnings despite the fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's ouster. The company announced it will stop selling H200 chips in China.

cards.title: Six AI Gadgets for Home Offices
cards.body: AI-powered tools from notetakers to webcams can upgrade your workspace. These gadgets enhance productivity and streamline daily tasks.

cards.title: Apple Developing Its Own AI Agent
cards.body: Apple is reportedly building AI agents to compete with Meta Muse, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. The agent would run directly on Mac systems.

cards.title: Anthropic Founders Pocket $2B in IPO
cards.body: Anthropic's seven founders each netted $280 million in a record-breaking IPO at $83 per share. The company raised nearly $105 billion total.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Charm Device Pricing
cards.body: Meta's upcoming AI wearable, the Muse Charm device, may cost around $300. Meta hasn't officially confirmed pricing but promised updates soon.

cards.title: Tech Outages Mirror Y2K, AI-Style
cards.body: Recent airline, banking, and productivity platform outages may be linked to deeper AI-related issues. Cybersecurity experts suggest more than coincidence is at play.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns From Nvidia
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following an affair, potentially impacting U.S.-China AI infrastructure competition. The scandal has significant national security implications.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Could Deliver $156B Charity
cards.body: At $95 per share, Anthropic's Public Benefit Foundation, employee donations, and company matching could total $156 billion for charity. The structure reflects the company's public benefit mission.

cards.title: Google Gives Gemini Mac Control
cards.body: Google's latest Gemini update brings an AI agent to Mac for organizing files and filling forms. The agent can handle multistep workflows automatically.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Agent Leaking Private Data
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI agent reportedly mixed conversations and exposed private data to wrong users. Instances included surfacing childcare requests, career advice, and bank balances from other accounts.

cards.title: Everful Raises $48.5M for Retailers
cards.body: Former Alibaba exec's Everful raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform. The service connects retailers with Chinese manufacturers for overseas procurement.

cards.title: Anthropic Nasdaq Debut Exceeds IPO Price
cards.body: Anthropic opened at $111 on Nasdaq, 33% above its $83 IPO price, raising over $80 billion. The strong debut reflects investor confidence in the AI lab.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Commits to Pacing AI
cards.body: Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development at the Nasdaq opening bell. The company will maintain this stance regardless of business or political pressure.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Tests AI Circular Financing
cards.body: Anthropic faces massive compute commitments as a public company while its infrastructure partners profit from its success. The circular financing structure raises questions about sustainability.

cards.title: Superhuman Expands Go Agent Everywhere
cards.body: Superhuman is making Go its central AI agent and expanding it into Docs and Mail. The agent will now be available across the company's product suite.

cards.title: Microsoft Asked 60K Employees to Quit
cards.body: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained buyout offers to 60,000 employees in October as AI-driven strategy. The move prioritizes workforce transformation over traditional layoffs.

cards.title: Critical Infrastructure Remains Largely Unpatchable
cards.body: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warned that much critical infrastructure cannot be patched against AI cyberattacks. He noted AI creates both opportunities and new security challenges.

cards.title: AI Capabilities Continue Exponential Growth Trajectory
cards.body: METR's latest report shows AI capabilities are improving exponentially, though models excel more at coding than judgment-based tasks. This update challenges assumptions about where AI currently stands on the capability curve.

cards.title: AI Learns to Smell Like Humans
cards.body: Researchers in New Jersey are training AI with human olfactory data to match human smell detection capabilities. The startup is cataloging every odor on Earth using experienced human sniffers and chemical analysis.

cards.title: Google Launches AI Chat in Search Homepage
cards.body: Google rolled out a redesigned search homepage featuring AI chat capabilities and removing the traditional search button. The move integrates conversational AI directly into the core search experience.

cards.title: Meta's AI Data Centers Threaten Climate Goals
cards.body: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero emissions target amid record emissions from AI data centers. The company faces mounting pressure to balance AI expansion with environmental commitments.

cards.title: Privacy Breach in AI Supply Chain Discovered
cards.body: A researcher planted 2 million canaries into the AI supply chain, exposing a major privacy disaster. The findings reveal vulnerabilities in how AI training data is handled and protected.

cards.title: AI Misidentifies Doritos Bag as Gun
cards.body: An AI gun detection system falsely triggered an alert after identifying a Doritos bag, traumatizing teens and sparking a lawsuit. The incident highlights critical accuracy issues in deployed AI safety systems.
